description: The file defines an interface class 'WifiManagerInterface' with pure virtual methods for managing Wi-Fi operations. It includes method declarations for Wi-Fi state inquiries, control operations, and event callbacks, serving as an abstract interface for Wi-Fi management within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: WifiManagerInterface
classes.description: An abstract interface class defining Wi-Fi management operations and event callbacks, to be implemented by concrete classes.

methods.name: getQuirks
methods.description: Retrieves various quirks or features supported by the Wi-Fi hardware.

methods.name: startScan
methods.description: Initiates a Wi-Fi scan for available networks.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the currently connected Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the Wi-Fi interface.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a Wi-Fi network specified in the parameters.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: saveSSID
methods.description: Saves an SSID for future connection.

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about the paired SSID.

methods.name: isPaired
methods.description: Checks if the device is paired.

methods.name: setSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables signal threshold change notifications.

methods.name: isSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if signal threshold change notifications are enabled.
